purpose: Evaluate the unchanged Local-Group peak model over every sealed CF4 posterior parent with 64 common midpoint/axis draws, then gate parent support, Monte-Carlo stability, and weighted CF4 compatibility before any conditional field or PM forward is allowed.

Local_Group_model.changes_from_V8: None. Peak targets, sigma, midpoint prior/proposal, geometry, and normalized constants remain unchanged.

parents.proposal: Exactly uniform and stratified: every parent appears once for each common integration draw.

integration.parent_marginal_log_evidence: logmeanexp over normalized log Z_peak + log p(midpoint) - log g(midpoint)

CF4_weighted_shift_test.statistic: sup_d(F_uniform(d)-F_evidence_weighted(d)) over the 256 sealed parent marginal deviances
CF4_weighted_shift_test.null: Randomly permute the 256 evidence weights over the fixed CF4 parent deviances.

execution.multiprocessing_start_method: fork after read-only filter and point sets are prepared
execution.memory_policy: Read-only filter is copy-on-write shared; each worker holds at most one parent mean transform.

failure_actions.invalid_numerical_or_lineage: Do not draw a scientific conclusion. Stop and repair lineage or numerical validity, then rerun the identical frozen program.
failure_actions.Monte_Carlo_or_proposal_instability: Do not alter physical targets. Freeze a new independent common-random integration bank with more draws; parent-support and CF4-tension diagnostics are not interpretable until this passes.
failure_actions.parent_support_or_CF4_compatibility: Stop the architecture. Do not tune peak targets or sigma after seeing the result; report tension or support collapse.

storage.write_policy: exclusive create; JSON evidence and lifecycle files only

decision.pass: Authorize a separately frozen parent-stratified conditional-field bank. Candidate generation and PM remain subject to that new program.
decision.fail: Apply the preregistered failure classification; do not generate fields or select a parent.
